item.subject: science
item.stem:
During Diwali, Meera observes four different changes happening at home and notes them in her notebook.

She remembers that combustion is a reaction in which a substance reacts with oxygen and produces heat or light.

Which of the changes Meera observed is combustion?

options.A: An electric bulb glowing and giving out heat when switched on
options.B: A piece of camphor burning in air with a flame during aarti
options.C: Wax melting near a hot diya and becoming soft
options.D: Water in a pan boiling and giving off steam on the stove
